summary.intent: Run the Phase 43 (feat/fuse-write-durability) UAT tests on a Linux/FUSE stack by building the API, mock-ipns-router, and Linux desktop apps locally against a Docker Compose stack at 192.168.133.49.
summary.outcome: All four UAT tests were executed: Tests 1, 2, and 3 passed; Test 4 reproduced the known G-43-UAT-02 gap (plaintext filenames in journal). Two new bugs were found — parked-write notification spam (fixed in sync/mod.rs and verified via dbus) and stale-FUSE-mount-after-crash not auto-recovering on Linux (logged as a GSD todo). Dev-key vault was cleaned up.

repo: cargo builds the desktop to the workspace-root target/ (e.g. cipher-box/target/debug/cipherbox-desktop), NOT the crate-local apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/debug/ — a stale Feb 28 binary in the crate-local path caused an extensive phantom-deadlock investigation
mock-ipns-router is a standalone npm package, not part of the pnpm workspace — requires separate npm install/build

test-login does NOT provision a vault; the client must run initialize_vault during onboarding — a pre-existing dev-key user with initialized_at=null on the shared Postgres caused a hang because isNew=false skipped init and tried to resolve a never-published IPNS record
Journal entries are intentionally retained after successful runtime uploads; they are only removed during the next-mount replay path (not at upload completion) — this is the CR-08 design point
Debug builds of the desktop load devUrl (http://localhost:1420) rather than the embedded dist, so WebKitGTK in a headless environment also requires a running vite dev server on :1420
GSD todos use area 'desktop-fuse' for FUSE-related desktop work and live in .planning/todos/pending/ with date-prefixed slugs
The docker compose stack (postgres, ipfs, redis, someguy) lives at 192.168.133.49; API migrations were already applied from a prior run

code.finding: Stale-mount recovery bug: after a SIGKILL, ~/CipherBox is a disconnected FUSE mount (ENOTCONN). mount_path.exists() calls stat() which returns ENOTCONN → false, so the code takes the create_dir_all branch. The directory entry still exists → EEXIST → 'Failed to create mount point: File exists'. The stale-cleanup else-branch is never reached. Fix: detect ENOTCONN before create_dir_all and run fusermount3 -u, or fall through EEXIST to the stale-cleanup path.

Level-triggered park notification: send_write_parked_notification fired on every WriteParked { failed > 0 } status emission (every 30s poll). Fixed by adding an AtomicU32 watermark (last_notified_failed) — toast only fires when failed count rises above the last-notified value; watermark resets on Idle/failed==0. The Syncing status (emitted at the start of every cycle) must NOT reset the watermark or spam returns.

journal.remove is in the mount-time replay path only — successful runtime uploads intentionally leave the journal entry as Pending until the next remount, where replay's already-present check cleans it up.
The sync daemon emits Syncing at the start of every cycle, then either WriteParked or Idle — this is why the notification watermark must not be reset on Syncing.

initialize_vault logs 'Publishing vault key blob' before any IPFS upload. If that log never appears, execution never entered the function body — check for stale binaries before assuming an async deadlock.

workflow: WebKitGTK in a headless Linux environment requires three env vars to work: WEBKIT_DISABLE_SANDBOX_THIS_IS_DANGEROUS=1 (bwrap cannot map uid), LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE=1 + MESA_LOADER_DRIVER_OVERRIDE=llvmpipe (Zink/Vulkan unavailable), and a running vite dev server on :1420 for debug builds
pkill patterns that include the launch command itself cause self-kills; use character-class bracket tricks (e.g. [c]ipherbox-desktop) to exclude the current shell process
dbus-monitor can count OS notifications over a timed window (gdbus monitor --session --dest org.freedesktop.Notifications) to verify edge-triggered deduplication
ptrace_scope=1 (default on many Linux systems) blocks attaching to non-child processes; launch the target under gdb as a child to get backtraces
When a GSD todo is committed, use --files to scope the commit to only the new todo file — avoids accidentally sweeping in uncommitted code changes

friction: Stale Feb 28 binary at apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/debug/cipherbox-desktop (crate-local path) was run instead of the current workspace-root binary for the entire debugging session — led to a multi-hour phantom async-deadlock investigation
Shared Postgres had a stale dev-key@cipherbox.local user with initialized_at=null from a prior run; required manual delete via Node script to get a clean new-user provisioning path
WebKitGTK web process refused to spawn in the headless environment without iterating through five separate env-var combinations before finding the working set
pkill self-matched the launch command line repeatedly across the session, requiring a workaround pattern
ptrace_scope=1 blocked gdb attach to live process; had to relaunch under gdb as a child
cargo build appeared to succeed but output to workspace-root target/ while the old crate-local binary remained untouched — no warning or error, silent stale artifact

Parked-write notification spam fix (sync/mod.rs) was built and verified but not yet committed to feat/fuse-write-durability
Linux UAT results not yet recorded into 43-UAT.md or a Linux-specific variant
